run_distributed_training: run distributed JEPA training jobs on a SLURM cluster using submitit with yaml config files
run_batch_launch: batch launch multiple training configs from a yaml list file using the --batch-launch flag
run_single_config: run a single training job by passing a yaml config file path with the --fname argument
review_Trainer_class: review the Trainer class that wraps pretraining params and launches the app via app_main
review_launch_app_with_parsed_args: review the launch_app_with_parsed_args function that creates a submitit AutoExecutor and batch submits Trainer jobs
